name: Yutori
notes: Yutori was founded by Abhishek Das, Devi Parikh and Dhruv Batra and announced its seed round in March 2025. Navigator models are called through an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoint: the caller sends a screenshot and a task, the model returns actions as tool calls, and the caller executes them and sends a fresh screenshot in an agent loop. n1.5 drives browsers in a normalized 1000x1000 coordinate space with a core set of 18 coordinate-based tools or an expanded set that adds element extraction, find, set_element_value and JavaScript execution, and can return JSON matching a caller schema. n2 operates a full desktop through batched GUI actions plus bash and file tools; the SDK ships local Docker and Daytona examples, and Yutori MCP runs it on the visible macOS desktop, sending screen contents to Yutori. A Python SDK wraps the APIs, a CLI runs research, browsing and Scout tasks, and an MCP server with workflow skills exposes these tasks and computer use to coding agents. Scouts monitor the web on a schedule, and Delegate is a consumer agent meant to complete handed-off tasks independently. Yutori also publishes a computer-use leaderboards page compiling reported results for six benchmarks. The publisher describes its Online-Mind2Web figure as independently verified and its Navi-Bench v2 and Westworld figures as its own evaluations.
summary: Yutori's web-agent platform: the Navigator computer-use model API (n1.5 for browsers, n2 for full desktops), task APIs for browsing, research and Scout web monitoring, and the Delegate personal agent.
